meta.Zones covered: Fountain & formal garden | central lawn & avenue | open gym & hedge beds
meta.Annotated videos: Three MP4 files in this folder, one per clip

headlineFindings: Vasant Vatika is the best-maintained park in the programme so far. The central lawn scores 80.4 overall with 32.4% lawn cover, 67% green cover and only 5.4% bare ground - the strongest single zone across all six parks surveyed.
The fountain is operating and the formal garden around it is in good order, matching the site record that the fountain is maintained. Irrigation scores 92.7 there and 91.4 on the central lawn.

The open gym zone is the clear exception and drags the park average down: 43% bare ground, 6.3% lawn and an irrigation score of 39.1. The ground under and around the equipment pad has failed while the rest of the park is green.
Hedges and shrub beds are in genuinely good condition - 1,288 shrub detections, clipped and continuous, confirming the site note that bushes are in good condition.
Cleanliness is the weakest park-wide indicator at 52.5. It is worst around the fountain garden (40.9), consistent with the site record of heavy litter.
Benches are well represented (324 records) and the built framework - kerbs, edging, paved areas and paths - is intact, with infrastructure scoring a consistent 76-77 across all three zones.
41 vehicle detections inside the park boundary.
An irrigation hose is visible lying across the ground in the open gym zone rather than a fixed system running - the same pattern seen at Lala Hardeval.

recommendations.DTU category: A1 Plantation & Green Cover / A3 Irrigation
recommendations.Finding: The open gym zone has 43% bare ground and 6.3% lawn with an irrigation score of 39.1, while the rest of the park sits above 90. The failure is localised to the area around the equipment pad.
recommendations.Recommended action: Extend the irrigation that works elsewhere in the park into the gym zone, then decompact and re-turf. Consider a defined hard or soft-surface apron around the equipment where foot traffic concentrates.

recommendations.Finding: Cleanliness is the weakest park-wide indicator at 52.5, worst in the fountain garden at 40.9, matching the site record of heavy litter.
recommendations.Recommended action: Increase sweeping and bin-emptying frequency around the fountain and the formal garden - the highest-footfall part of the park.

recommendations.Finding: The site record notes deteriorating paint on the gym equipment. The equipment was detected and scored on paint integrity.
recommendations.Recommended action: Inspect the lowest paint-integrity scorers in the anomaly register; sand, prime and repaint, and check fixings and footings.

recommendations.Finding: 41 vehicle detections inside the park boundary.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm whether the movements are authorised maintenance access; otherwise enforce vehicle restrictions.

recommendations.Finding: The fountain is operating and maintained, hedge beds are clipped and healthy, the central lawn is the strongest in the whole programme, and the built framework is intact.
recommendations.Recommended action: Maintain the current regime. This park is a useful benchmark for what the other five should look like.

recommendations.Finding: The site record describes a water body that is unclear with algae growth. These three clips show a clean, operating fountain and no algal signature.
recommendations.Recommended action: Either the affected water body is elsewhere in the park and not covered by this footage, or the condition has changed. Worth a targeted flight to settle it.

recommendations.Finding: No class exists for: gazebo, streetlight, dustbin, water pipes, boundary wall distinct from kerb, or dead trees as a class separate from dry vegetation.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm which matter most for the DDA report and they can be added.

recommendations.Finding: No .SRT telemetry accompanied these clips, and this is a single-date capture.
recommendations.Recommended action: Export flight logs with the video to unlock geo-tagging; repeat the flight path later for change detection against this baseline.
